style: Botanical cut-paper collage with exact paper-color relationship diagrams
provider: Built-in image generation and deterministic SVG diagrams
lessonTitles: One path through a food chain
note: Images are illustrative, not scale drawings or identification guides. Feeding arrows point from food to eater. The web is a selected model, not every connection in a real ecosystem. The 10% figure is an approximation, not a universal constant or a count of animals. Energy is transformed and dispersed as heat, not created, destroyed or recycled by decomposers; mineral nutrients cycle. Earthworms are detritivores that assist decomposition; fungi and bacteria are decomposers in the narrower sense. The bacteria image is a magnified symbolic view, not a photograph of a deer carcass. Sunlight starts the meadow model; some ecosystems use chemical energy instead. Yellowstone changes have multiple causes, so the wolf story is not a controlled before-and-after experiment.
